opportunities.opportunity_id: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review. In special cases, and by prior agreement, we accept applications for up to £750,000. Most of the grants we award are below £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the priority questions, be relevant, have a clear path to impact, a clear conceptual framework, appropriate and rigorous methodology, experienced team, and offer good value for money. Individuals without formal employment, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools, further education colleges, undergraduates, master’s students, PhD fees, academic posts, ongoing costs, dissemination-only projects, local charities, replacement for statutory funding, local social services, requests for financial help, projects led by overseas organizations (unless UK-focused dissemination is planned) are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation's five interconnected priorities and aim to improve lives in the UK.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on racial inequalities, discrimination, and pathways to racial justice, particularly those that take an intersectional approach. Applicants from diverse backgrounds, especially from racially minoritised communities, are encouraged. Partnership applications are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society.
